content:
Hi everyone!

I'm interested in contributing to Rust for Linux and eventually upstreaming Rust code into the mainline Linux kernel.

I'd like to start with a small, useful contribution and learn the project's review and patch-submission workflow.

Could you point me toward a suitable good-first issue, an existing Rust abstraction that needs improvement, or a subsystem where Rust contributions would be welcome?

I'd also appreciate guidance on the prerequisites and testing requirements for a first contribution.

Thank you!
This topic was moved here from #Modules > inquiry by Miguel Ojeda.

Please take a look at https://rust-for-linux.com/contributing if you haven't seen it yet -- I have some tips and suggestions there, in particular "Finding tasks and issues to work on".

(I deleted a duplicate of your message, and moved the other one here -- I hope that is what you intended)
